WITH batsman_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, COALESCE(SUM(runs_scored), 0) as runs
    FROM batsman_scored
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
extra_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, COALESCE(SUM(extra_runs), 0) as extras
    FROM extra_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
over_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no,
           b.runs + COALESCE(e.extras, 0) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_over b
    LEFT JOIN extra_over e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
),
max_over_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.innings_no, o.total_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN max_over_runs m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.total_runs = m.max_runs
),
max_overs_bowler AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mo.match_id, mo.over_id, mo.innings_no, mo.total_runs, bb.bowler
    FROM max_overs mo
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON mo.match_id = bb.match_id AND mo.over_id = bb.over_id AND mo.innings_no = bb.innings_no
),
bowler_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM max_overs_bowler
    GROUP BY bowler
),
top_bowler_match AS (
    SELECT mob.bowler, mob.match_id, mob.total_runs
    FROM max_overs_bowler mob
    JOIN bowler_max bm ON mob.bowler = bm.bowler AND mob.total_runs = bm.max_runs
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT tb.bowler, tb.match_id, tb.total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tb.total_runs DESC, tb.bowler ASC) as rn
    FROM top_bowler_match tb
)
SELECT r.rn, p.player_name, r.match_id, r.total_runs, m.venue, m.match_date
FROM ranked r
JOIN player p ON r.bowler = p.player_id
JOIN match m ON r.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY r.rn
